title_zh: 月租計劃專享高達 8% 折扣
summary_en: Book by 30 November 2026 and quote the code for up to 8% off. Call leasing for details.
summary_zh: 於 2026年11月30日前預訂，並提供折扣碼即可享高達 8% 折扣。詳情請聯絡租務部。
description_en: Enjoy exclusive savings with our early bird offer! Book any designated monthly stay plan on or before 30 November 2026 and quote the promo code to receive up to 8% discount. Secure your stay today. Limited availability!
description_zh: 把握限時禮遇！由即日起至2026年11月30日前預訂指定月租計劃，並於預訂時提供折扣碼，即可尊享高達 8% 租金折扣。名額有限！立即預約參觀或查詢詳情！
terms_en:
Discount offer applies to leases commencing between 1 January 2027 and 30 June 2027.

This offer cannot be used in conjunction with any other promotions.

For enquiries and further details, please contact our Leasing Department at +852 2700 1122 or via email at [leasing@onedundashk.com](mailto:leasing@onedundashk.com).
terms_zh:
此優惠適用於租期由2027年1月1日至2027年6月30日期間起租的合約。

此優惠不能與其他推廣優惠同時使用。

如欲查詢優惠詳情，請致電 +852 2700 1122或電郵至 [leasing@onedundashk.com](mailto:leasing@onedundashk.com) 與租務部聯絡。
image_alt: Early Bird promotion: up to 8% off monthly packages
